title: AMD Crushed Earnings! Is The Stock Cheap Enough To Buy?
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Couch Investor (in a collaboration with The Motley Fool) walks through AMD's latest quarter, which he calls excellent: revenue up 45% year on year and above the high end of guidance, non-GAAP EPS up 74%, gross margins up 190 basis points year on year, operating income up 75% with operating margin reaching 29.3%. Data centre is the engine — segment operating income $2.9B, up 168% year on year, margins up from 25% to 34% — while client was up 7% year on year, gaming down 40% year on year, and embedded back at 41% operating margin. Q4 guidance is around $17B revenue (66% growth year on year, 55% gross margin, data centre up 50% quarter on quarter), and management expects over 80% revenue growth in 2027 with data centre over 80% of sales, implying above $90B revenue versus analyst expectations near $90B. The weak point is free cash flow of only $554M, with inventory up $3B quarter on quarter, which management attributes to building for data-centre demand. He closes as a happy AMD shareholder who likes what he has seen and heard, noting the stock has more than doubled year to date but pulled back so the company is now growing into its valuation — but he makes no explicit buy, sell or hold call in the video, so no call-event is recorded.
